title: 881. Find and Replace Pattern

examples.explanation: "mee" and "aqq" repeat their last two letters exactly like "abb" does. "abc" and "deq" use three distinct letters, "dkd" repeats the first and last, and "ccc" repeats everything.
Every single-letter word trivially shares the shape of a one-letter pattern.

hints: Reduce each word to its repetition shape by replacing every letter with the index of its first appearance.
A word fits exactly when its shape equals the pattern's shape; compare the two encodings.
